gap.name: gap
gap.value: Diesel and OTB need opposite things from the same supplier: Diesel wants innovation to feed a winning, youth-led digital push; the group wants cheap, consistent assets to stop the bleed on a −14.7% wholesale channel. The gap is one partner that can play both — premium AI imagery for the brand, commodity-cost consistency for the group and its wholesale partners.
